title: Keep semantically incomplete TABLECONTENT on the raw-only route
trigger: The existing fast object-dispatch selector showed that a bounded TABLECONTENT parse could return true with m_semanticContentComplete=false, yet the dispatcher still emitted a typed addTableContent callback for a profile explicitly marked raw-only.

sections.20.4.96.2: R24 and later store table content as part of the TABLE entity data; it is not a separate TABLECONTENT DWG object.
sections.20.4.97: Describes the standalone TABLECONTENT object and field families for the R21-era representation. It does not qualify the observed incomplete standalone payload or its unsupported semantics.

change.behavior: For a versioned raw-only TABLECONTENT profile, a successful bounded parse is emitted through addTableContent only if m_semanticContentComplete is true. Incomplete or rejected content uses the pristine common-shell probe and exact raw frame with typedPayloadValidated=false.
change.preserves: No DWG byte interpretation, modeled field, or support claim changed.

testCorrections.behavior: The AC1027/AC1032 truncated common-handle retry controls now expect readObjects to return true when record-level failure is softened, while asserting one object parse failure, source-frame withholding, following-frame publication, and corrected-input recovery.
testCorrections.reason: The established reader policy is to continue and report record-level failures without failing the entire OBJECTS read.

disposition.TABLECONTENT: The modeled-but-semantically-incomplete AC1032 body remains raw-only, does not mutate the caller's preexisting typed destination, and preserves the following complete OBJECT frame.
disposition.P5 producer/span gates: Remain open; this change does not resolve field spans, standalone-R21 producer provenance, native display, or R24 inline TABLE semantics.
disposition.P6-B: Remains open; S45 is independent of PERSUBENTMGR member-schema evidence.

next: Keep incomplete TABLECONTENT on the raw-only route. Continue the remaining source/span and native-qualification gates; do not treat this selector pass as TABLE format support.
